What we do
Practical AI security, built in public.
AI Village connects education, experimentation, and community practice so people can understand, test, and secure AI systems.
Red-team AI systems
Run and learn from practical exercises that expose how AI systems fail, where defenses help, and what responsible testing looks like.
Teach AI security
Publish workshops, labs, and learning material for people moving from curiosity to hands-on AI security practice.
Host community events
Bring hackers, builders, researchers, and policy-minded practitioners together at DEF CON and other community events.
Publish field notes and resources
Share technical writing, recaps, and open resources from the people doing the work.
